description: Mandatory pre-suit notice to Government / Public Officer under Section 80 of CPC, 1908

fields.label: Facts of the Case (detailed)
fields.placeholder: Describe the cause of action, relevant dates, documents, and how the Government / officer has wronged your client...

fields.label: What do you demand the noticee to do?
fields.placeholder: e.g., release outstanding payment of Rs. X with interest...

response_deadline.logic: 'two months from receipt of this notice'

sections.template:
Subject: Legal Notice under Section 80 CPC — prior to institution of suit against the Government / Public Officer

Sir/Madam,

Under instructions from and on behalf of my client, {applicant_name}, I hereby serve upon you this legal notice under Section 80 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, and call upon you to note the following:

sections.prompt_context: Generate 5-8 numbered paragraphs for a Legal Notice under Section 80 CPC. This is a NOTICE, not a petition — the tone should be firm but professional (advocate writing to a government officer). Para 1: Introduce the client ({applicant_name}) and their standing. Paras 2-5: Narrate the facts chronologically based on: {facts_narrative}. Include specific dates, amounts, document references. Para 6-7: State the legal basis — S.80 CPC mandates 2-month notice before suing Government. Final para: State the demand clearly. Do NOT generate the closing or advocate signature — those are template-handled. Use numbered paragraphs.

sections.template:
DEMAND

You are hereby called upon to {demand} within a period of two (2) months from the date of receipt of this notice, failing which my client shall be constrained to initiate appropriate legal proceedings before the competent civil court, at your risk, cost, and consequences, without any further reference to you.

filing_checklist: Send via Registered Post AD (Acknowledgement Due) — retain receipt
Send additional copy via Speed Post
Retain photocopy of notice with postal receipts
Keep proof of delivery (AD card) safely — needed at time of filing suit
Wait mandatory 2 months from date of receipt before filing suit
Attach all supporting documents referenced in the notice
Verify noticee's correct designation and office address
